page_title: Eagle - Organize design files has never been easier

sources.entry: Eagle App - Asset manager for images, videos, audio, fonts, and design files.

summary.name: Eagle
summary.one_liner: Eagle is a design asset manager for collecting, organizing, searching and browsing images, GIFs, videos, audio, fonts and other design files in one place.
use_cases: collect images from websites with a browser extension
find images by color, tag or meaning
manage video, GIF and audio files for projects
preview and sort fonts without installing them
catalog UI and UX research screenshots
summary.what_it_does: Eagle lets users collect images, screenshots, design files and links through a browser extension, drag and drop, or clipboard, then organize them with tags, hierarchical folders, smart folders and ratings. Search covers keywords, color palettes, filters and search by image, and the page describes AI features such as visual and semantic search and an AI Action workflow for automated renaming and tagging. Files such as images, GIFs, videos, audio and fonts can be previewed on hover or with the spacebar without opening them. A plugin center and a JavaScript/HTML plugin system are also described.
notable: AI search: visual, semantic and cross-source search plus an AI Action workflow for automated organizing
Browser extension with batch save, one-click HD download and Alt + Right-click saving
Smart folders, tagging and duplicate finder for large libraries
Plugins built with JavaScript and HTML
caveats: Mac download requires macOS 10.15 or later
One-time purchase after a 30-day full-feature trial; no subscription stated
